description: This file contains functions for deduplicating messaging payloads, normalizing provider and thread IDs, and determining whether to suppress messaging tool replies, specific to reply payload handling in a messaging system.

methods.name: filterMessagingToolDuplicates
methods.description: Filters out duplicate messaging tool payloads based on text content.

methods.name: filterMessagingToolMediaDuplicates
methods.description: Filters out duplicate media URLs in messaging payloads.

methods.name: shouldSuppressMessagingToolReplies
methods.description: Determines whether messaging tool replies should be suppressed based on sent targets and provider info.
